rubric.role_summary: Software engineer building developer-platform tools, APIs, and integration infrastructure, including internal platform capabilities and customer-facing functionality.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Software engineer building developer-platform tools, APIs, and integration infrastructure, including internal platform capabilities and customer-facing functionality.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience shipping production software.
- Experience with TypeScript.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs.
- Experience driving teams toward shared goals while balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, interests, and career development goals.
- Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences.
- 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end.
- Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
